paragraphs.text:
As torrential rains pour from the
sky, you seek shelter from the
weather in a ramshackle hut. As
you get close, the ground shakes
and a giant earthworm lunges at
you.
Giant Worm, L4 animal, 8 Life, on
any Defense roll of 1, it inflicts 2
damage. 1 damage otherwise. Once
reduced to 4 or fewer Life, roll d6. Ona 1 to 3  it will flee, retreating
underground; on a 4 to 6, it will
continue to fight to the death.
If you survive the fight, you find a
random item in the hut. You also
gain 1 XP if you kill the giant worm.
